description: This PHP class defines a console command 'instance:reset-db' for resetting the database to its initial state by invoking the DatabaseBackupService's restore method. It is part of the OrangeHRM functional testing plugins, providing a command-line utility for test setup.

classes.name: ResetDatabaseCommand
classes.description: A console command class that resets the database to its initial state during functional testing.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the name of the console command, 'instance:reset-db'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the command with its description.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the database reset operation and indicates success.
